_comments: THE HOURLY ACTIVITY SYNC. MJ's SchedulingEngine is the mechanism — no external cron.
· JobTypeID — the seeded Action type (ActionScheduledJobDriver). The job does not contain
logic; it invokes Common.SyncActivities, which keeps the schedule and the work separable.
· CronExpression `0 0 * * * *` — SIX fields, seconds first, so this is the top of every hour.
· ConcurrencyMode Skip — overlapping runs would fetch the same window twice. Dedupe absorbs
the writes; two runs racing to advance the same watermark can leave it behind.
· MissedRunPolicy RunOnce — not RunAll. There is no date filter on the fetch, so catching up
ten missed hours would make ten identical requests for the most recent N messages.
SAFE TO SHIP Active: Graph refuses live fetch until an Application Access Policy exists, so an
hourly run writes nothing until a deployment opts in. A host with no connection reports
NO_CONNECTIONS. Neither state writes LastError.
OwnerUserID and NotifyUserID are left NULL: naming a person here would seed one deployment's
staff into another's database.
Configuration is a native JSON object (MJ/metadata/CLAUDE.md §1c). No sync block.

fields.Name: Common — Activity Sync (hourly)
fields.Description: Pulls messages and calendar items for every Active-or-Error activity-sync connection and files the relevant ones as Activities. Downstream apps enrich in-stream; they do not own this job.

_comments: NIGHTLY PERSON ENRICHMENT — APOLLO. Ships DISABLED (plan D10): enabling it starts spending vendor credits.
Turn on in the Scheduling app after an Apollo credential exists. Set the CompanyID param if the key lives on a Company Integration rather than APOLLO_API_KEY.
Runs at 07:00 UTC (Apollo) / 08:30 UTC (People Data Labs); with MaxRuntimeMinutes 60 the two can never
overlap, so they never write the same person at the same time (plan R11).
MissedRunPolicy Skip: a missed night needs no catch-up; the next run picks up everyone still eligible.
MaxRuntimeMinutes 60 > the action's TimeBudgetMinutes 45, so the engine stops itself before the lease expires.
The Action driver heartbeats once before the action starts, not during it.
Neither job sets Facets, so each writes everything its provider supports; a host that enables both should
set the Apollo job's Facets to Employment,LinkedIn and the PDL job's to Education,LinkedIn (release notes).
Param lookups are qualified with &Action= so another action's same-named param can never be picked.
OwnerUserID and NotifyUserID stay NULL. Configuration is a native JSON object. No sync block.

fields.Name: Common — Person Enrichment: Apollo (nightly)
fields.Description: Enriches existing People with employment and LinkedIn data from Apollo.io. Never creates People. Disabled until an admin turns it on.
